name: deck-studio
description: Shape, create, revise and publish communication decks in HTML, PDF and editable PowerPoint.

interface.longDescription: Turn notes, approved content or an existing deck into local HTML/PDF or native editable PowerPoint, with 56 visual systems and rendered inspection. Requires a local executor, Node.js 24.22.1+, npm, Python 3.9+ and explicit package-owned dependency setup. HTML rendering uses package-owned Chromium; PowerPoint render inspection also needs LibreOffice and Poppler. The HTML PDF export contains slide images. Optional self-hosted galleries use your own library, access policy and gateway; installation publishes nothing and includes no hosted account. Removing the plugin preserves your decks and independently running services.
defaultPrompt: Use Deck Studio to shape my material into a clear, well-designed deck for its audience.
